limits: The review reconciles existing bounded evidence; it does not constitute a full source-built M3JDK21 build.
Resource observations apply only to the recorded workload; no general speed or retained-heap guarantee is inferred.
The earlier failed native closure attempt remains preserved and is not counted as success; native-final is the sole final native receipt.
review_method: Manual complete source/diff review plus read-only byte/hash, receipt, XML, class inventory, symbol and raw-log reconciliation; no compiler, test, benchmark or native gate rerun.
scope: Exact selected opposite-known-order M3LongIndexProjection atom and its serial SDK, generated Java, and frozen native-final proof chain.

findings: Comparator-owned IllegalArgumentException is swallowed in the bounded read-only map witness. Both comparator-failure and the original default readonly mode stop at that first failure; their later mutable-set assertion is not reached.

The ordinary read-only iterator retains the indexed callback path and exceeds the original linear-work oracle: 787456 predicate calls for a 1024-element backing list. There is no traversal speed claim.
The ordinary read-only iterator does not detect the backing mutation in the original fail-fast witness. Later assertions in that mode are not reached.
separate_retained_wrapper_findings.interpretation: Existing live-wrapper failures are preserved separately and are not results from or regressions caused by the selected detached-projection atom.

source_review.cost: The selected path partitions and copies each selected index once into one result int[]; O(n) time and index storage. No whole value copy or per-row objects are introduced.
source_review.native_bodies: All three actual current C owners match retained immutable Git objects and SHA-256 pins; the stronger admitted-span native window implementation remains unchanged.
source_review.other_paths: Encounter-order stable merge, same-order descriptor sharing, empty/singleton behavior, slicing, filtering, validation, detached snapshot ownership and address/native calls are unchanged.
source_review.physical_offsets: The helper scans absolute index positions inside [from,to), passes base zero to the existing address kernel, and copies original physical indices. Sliced/filtered partial groups remain bounded; no prefix/suffix or double-offset exposure.
source_review.public_contract: Only a private helper, its internal branch and cost documentation changed; recorded public/protected signatures and descriptors are byte-identical across baseline, generated Java and native-final.
source_review.selected_branch: After the unchanged same-order/size<2 guard, order!=ENCOUNTER identifies exactly the opposite known sorted direction.
source_review.tie_stability: Whole equal-value groups move in reverse group order; each group is copied forward, retaining physical occurrence order, including equal signed-long extrema.
